prompt: An IR has a strong C=O at ~1730 cm⁻¹ PLUS a diagnostic doublet near 2720 and 2820 cm⁻¹. What functional group?
explanation: Aldehydes have a unique pair of C-H stretches at ~2720 and ~2820 cm⁻¹ (Fermi doublet from the aldehyde C-H). Combined with a C=O at ~1725, this nails it as an aldehyde — no other functional group shows that doublet pattern.
